name: chi-content-single-mode
description: Isolates the c=0 (2,1)-block (the only H₃ block with internal tower structure) and tests whether its winding tower fits a single-x q-Bessel. Bar-odd coefficients are rational, but the single-x over-determination residual does NOT shrink (≈480% k=3, 606% k=5, 186% k=7, erratic). So the §4a single-x failure is not merely multi-mode mixing — even one content mode is not single-x q-Bessel under the winding tower. NEGATIVE; nothing wired; TIERED.
tower_variable: winding iterate β^k (k odd, parity preserved)
reading: The single-x q-Bessel identification fails even for an isolated content mode; the discrete strand/winding/framing tower variables are not the q-Bessel contraction parameter (or the bar-odd object is not single-x q-Bessel). Combined with PR #2496, the single-x §4a template is refuted across every tower direction tried.
